The argument that preference smuggles induction (SRC_001) depends on the rejection of the 'non-inductive conjectural risk management' defense (SRC_004). REFUTED IF: The 'risk management' strategy in SRC_004 is shown to be fully operational and rational without requiring any bridge principle linking past survival to future success, rendering the 'crypto-inductivism' charge in SRC_001 a category error regarding the definition of 'rational action'.
